mechanism_narrative: A rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 3% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or CPIAUCSL YoY > 3% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or UNRATE increase > 0.5% MoM does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Real Final Sales of Domestic Product (RSAFS) by more than 1% MoM signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or RSAFS decline > 1% MoM does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or INDPRO increase > 2% YoY does not correlate with subsequent economic growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary cycle, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000, it signals a tight labor market with strong job growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with strong job growth
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with subsequent economic strength.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% YoY and real final sales (RSAFS) are stagnant (change < 0.5% MoM), it signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST decreases > 10% YoY and RSAFS change < 0.5% MoM
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, when GDP (GDPC1) growth slows to less than 1% YoY and industrial production (INDPRO) is flat (change < 0.5% YoY), it signals a potential economic peak, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth < 1% YoY and INDPRO change < 0.5% YoY
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with subsequent economic downturn.
